scenes.line1: Why does EF Core slow down?
scenes.say: Ever wonder why your app crawls when using Entity Framework Core? Can you pinpoint the culprit?

scenes.label: Tracking
scenes.sub: Excessive tracking wastes memory and slows queries.
scenes.say: Too much entity tracking eats up memory and drags down query speed.
To catch performance issues, I check logs, review the generated SQL, and use profilers to spot bottlenecks.
Disabling tracking for read-only queries and inspecting the SQL helps me catch inefficiencies early.

scenes.question: What causes the N+1 query problem?
scenes.right: Lazy loading triggers extra queries for each related entity, leading to N plus one problems.
scenes.say: What leads to the N plus one query issue? It's usually lazy loading, which fires extra queries for every related entity.
